mapper.select: SELECT cart_item_id, product_id, username FROM tbl_cart WHERE username = #{username} AND product_id = #{productId} LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT c.cart_item_id, c.product_id, p.name as product_name, p.price as product_price, p.image_url, po.option_id, po.option_name, po.option_price, cio.quantity as option_quantity, c.username FROM tbl_cart c INNER JOIN tbl_products p ON c.product_id = p.product_id INNER JOIN tbl_cart_item_options cio ON c.cart_item_id = cio.cart_item_id INNER JOIN tbl_product_options po ON cio.option_id = po.option_id WHERE c.username = #{username} ORDER BY c.product_id, po.option_id
